import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for the event data. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def generate_event_html(title: str, description: str, date: str, extra_notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title : str The name or heading of the event. description : str A detailed description (may contain newlines). date : str The scheduled date of the event. extra_notes : str Any additional information or instructions. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string ready for rendering. """ # Escape all user-provided content to neutralize potential XSS attacks. safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') safe_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(extra_notes, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Construct the final HTML safely. return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes )
